sophia-cs: Hi team — cust614 (org:cust-614) reporting embeddings suddenly dropped from 1536 -> 1024 after we pinned an embedding model last week. They started seeing it after a maintenance deploy at ~2026-03-16T10:22Z. Sample response attached.
\nmaria-support: Sorry to hear that. Can you paste the request_id + exact model name they pinned and one example API call? Well escalate if needed.
\nsophia-cs: request_id=rec-0a1b2c3d, pinned model: "embed-large-v2:locked-20260211". Customer call (redacted keys):

```
POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "embed-large-v2:locked-20260211",
  "input": "how to set up webhooks",
  "batch": false
}
```

Response (truncated):
```
{
  "data": [{
    "embedding": [0.012, -0.003, ...],
    "embedding_length": 1024
  }]
}
```

They say historically this model returned 1536-length vectors.
\nops-bot: deploy: canary respin completed by infra-bot at 2026-03-16T10:20:43Z. Route change: embed-large-v2 -> embed-large-v2-q8 (auto-fallback) :warning:
\nmaria-support: @tj-mleng @luca-eng adding you for a quick investigation. Customer is blocked — embeddings power their semantic search.\\
tj-mleng: thanks. initial thought: either routing fell back to a quantized variant with a different vector_size or a model registration mismatch. Can you paste the full raw response JSON (including metadata) and the routing headers if available?\\
sophia-cs: full response + headers (sanitized):

```
X-Request-Id: rec-0a1b2c3d
X-Route: region-us-east1->pool-dedicated-7
X-Model-Served: embed-large-v2-q8
{
  "object": "list",
  "data": [{
    "object": "embedding",
    "embedding": [0.01, -0.003, ...],
    "metadata": {"vector_size": 1024},
    "index": 0
  }]
}
```
\\luca-eng: I can see the X-Model-Served header: embed-large-v2-q8 — that explains the 1024 dims. Need to know why requests for the pinned model were routed to the q8 variant. Two possibilities:
- routing policy decided q8 variant was compatible and picked it due to capacity constraints
- model aliasing: embed-large-v2 namespaced alias accidentally pointed to the q8 artifact after the canary
\\tj-mleng: can you dump the model registry entry for both artifacts? (rctl models get embed-large-v2 --json and rctl models get embed-large-v2-q8 --json)
\\luca-eng: registry snippets:

```
# embed-large-v2 (artifact id: m-1536-a)
name: embed-large-v2
artifact: m-1536-a
vector_size: 1536
variants: ["embed-large-v2:locked-20260211"]

# embed-large-v2-q8 (artifact id: m-1024-q8)
name: embed-large-v2-q8
artifact: m-1024-q8
vector_size: 1024
variants: ["embed-large-v2-q8:autogen-q8-20260316"]
```
\\tj-mleng: registry looks fine. Next step: check routing policy blobs for pinned sessions. If a pinned session lost its strong pin (expired TTL) requests can be eligible for variant fallback.
\\maria-support: Customer said they explicitly pinned via the console earlier (UI shows locked). They provided screenshot of the lock indicator. Could TTL have been shorter than UI showed?
\\luca-eng: Possible. Im pulling routing logs for pool-dedicated-7 around the request time.
\\luca-eng: Routing logs excerpt:

```
2026-03-16T10:22:40Z req=rec-0a1b2c3d model_req=embed-large-v2:locked-20260211 pin_check=pass pool_alloc=full fallback_policy=allow_variant_match selected_variant=embed-large-v2-q8 reason="capacity_exhaustion"
```

So the pin check passed, but the runtime allowed variant matching and selected q8 due to capacity_exhaustion. That is a bug: pinned requests should not pick a different-embedding-dim variant even in fallback mode — we should only fallback to variants with identical vector_size.
\\tj-mleng: yep that's the invariant: pinned pins must guarantee shape compatibility. This looks like a policy bug introduced in routing v2.4 where variant-compatibility checks were relaxed for latency SLOs.
\\maria-support: Urgent mitigation options? Customer is inprod.
\\luca-eng: Immediate mitigations:
- Toggle cluster-level flag env ROUTING_ENFORCE_VECTOR_COMPAT=true (hot patch) — will force strict shape checks for pinned requests. This requires infra approval but low-risk.
- Short term customer workaround: set header "x-redwood-force-variant: embed-large-v2:locked-20260211" on calls to force the exact artifact.

I can flip the env flag for pool-dedicated-7 now if ops approves.
\\tj-mleng: I'll prepare a patch to routing that adds a hard assert: if request.pin != null and pinned_variant.vector_size != served_variant.vector_size -> reject rather than fallback. Will submit a hotfix; ETA 4h.
\\ops-bot: incident INC-9872 created by luca-eng: "pinned-variant-compatibility-relaxation -> embed dim mismatch". Sev: high. Pager on-call.
\\maria-support: communicated to customer: suggested header workaround + offered to roll their pinned model to a different variant if they prefer an immediate config change. Also offered 2 days of credit while we fix. They opted for the header workaround for now.
\\sophia-cs: Customer confirmed header workaround worked locally — they get 1536 vectors again. Thanks. They want confirmation when a permanent fix is deployed and proof no other org hit this.
\\tj-mleng: I'll run a quick audit across routing logs to find other instances where pinned requests served a different vector_size. Will report back with a list within 2 hours.
\\luca-eng: Flipped ROUTING_ENFORCE_VECTOR_COMPAT=true on pool-dedicated-7 at 2026-03-16T11:05Z — interim mitigation in place. Bob from infra validated no regressions.
\\maria-support: Noted. Customer updated and pleased. Filing follow-up: add unit tests for pinned-route invariant, soft rollback plan, postmortem after fix.
\\sophia-cs: Thank you all — please keep me posted here. :pray:
\\tj-mleng: Audit partial results: found 3 other orgs with pinned requests that temporarily served mismatched vector_size in last 48h. Reached out to affected customers. Will include list in INC-9872.
\\luca-eng: Working on the routing hotfix PR now. ETA merge + canary 3h, full rollout 6h. Will post PR link once ready.
\\maria-support: Great work. Marking this thread as monitoring — will update last_message_ts when PR merged. :white_check_mark:
